sn46.28:1.1: Nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ vo bhikkhave maggaṃ desissāmi || taṃ suṇātha || || Katamo ca bhikkhave nibbedhabhāgiyo maggo || || Yad idam satta bojjhaṅgā || katame sattā || Satisambojjhaṅgo || pa-pe || Upekhāsambojjhaṅgo ti || || Evam vutte āyasmā Udāyi Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Katham bhāvitā nu kho bhante satta bojjhaṅgā katham bahulīkatā nibbedhāya saṃvattantī ti
